_about: Everything Rowan can carry (UIX-07). Weapons, shields, armor and food are listed in combat.json with their
numbers; this file adds what combat.json doesn't have (currency and materials), plus extra fields for any item:
'rarity' (common, uncommon, rare, legendary: the colour of its name and frame), 'text' (its description,
STY-09), 'bound': true (can't be dropped). Weapons, shields and armor are 'uncommon' unless a rarity is given.
'stack' is how many fit in one backpack slot. Currency doesn't take a slot.

copper.name: Copper Shard
copper.text: Clipped bits of old coin. Every stall in Aldmoor takes them, and nobody asks where they came from.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.text: Thick grey fur, still smelling of the woods. A tanner or a merchant will pay for it.

bear_pelt.name: Bear Pelt
bear_pelt.text: Heavy brown fur from a bear of the vale. Worth a good deal to the right buyer.

dawnblade.text: Grandfather's old longsword. Nobody else wanted it, and it felt wrong to leave it behind. It hums, sometimes, when the sky turns strange.

iron_shortsword.text: A plain iron blade of the Watch's issue. Light, honest and easy to swing.

flanged_mace.text: An iron head of ridged flanges on an ash haft. Made for denting helmets, and the heads inside them.

bandits_cutlass.text: A curved, notched blade with a brass knuckle guard. Every brigand on the south road seems to carry one.

bandits_great_maul.text: An iron-banded block of oak on a long haft. Crude, heavy and very hard to argue with.

leng_sabre.text: A serrated sabre with a ram's skull for a pommel. The steel is cold to the touch, even in the sun.

goblin_shiv.text: A sharpened strip of scrap bound to a bone grip. Goblins favour it for stabbing in the back.

tome_of_wards.text: A heavy book of protective prayers, chained to a belt. Its Ward absorbs half again as much harm and holds for longer. Old Aldric's hand fills the margins.

wooden_round_shield.text: Planks, an iron boss and a painted rim. It has stopped more arrows than it should have.

arm_01.text: Rowan's own work gloves, stiff with barn muck and worn through at one thumb.

trs_01.text: A travelling coat patched so often that little of the original cloth remains.

leg_01.text: Work trousers and boots. Comfortable, and caked in the mud of Oswin's fields.

apple.text: A red apple from the Brackenvale orchards. Heals a little over a few seconds.

bread.text: A heel of brown bread. Heals over a few seconds.

stew.text: A pot of thick stew, still warm somehow. Heals a great deal over a few seconds.
